label: first input token is "r" (t=0)
explanation: Fires exactly when the very first original token (step t=0) is the letter r. On the dev split it is a perfect step-level detector (P=R=F1=1.0). The activation is binary, a constant 1.301 every time it fires, so nothing modulates its magnitude. It never fires on r at any later original position, on the delimiter, or anywhere in the copy phase (including when r is being output). It also does not fire on any other token at t=0. Sequence length, digit count, and repeats of r have no effect beyond the base rate.
